# Configure the API client

1. Open the configuration page.
2. Select the production profile.
3. Save the configuration.

Call `client.fetch_resource()` to retrieve the resource. See the [API reference](https://example.com/api/utilize) for parameter details.

| Setting | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `request_timeout` | Limits the wait time. |
